component.name: ClipThat!
component.summary: Paste a Link. Grab Your Clip.

description.p: Queue precise clips from YouTube links. ClipThat! downloads the full source at up to 1080p and encodes your chosen time range as an H.264/AAC MKV, including English captions when available.
Choose an output folder and process clips sequentially. Downloading and encoding tools are included.
